quest.title: Divine Ingenuity
quest.description: Katheryne of the Liyue Harbor Adventurers' Guild seems to be looking for you...

dialogues.speaker: Katheryne
dialogues.text: Hello there, Traveler. Great timing: we have a commission that I believe would best be taken up by you.

response.speaker: Katheryne
response.text: Well, it involves a hitherto unknown Domain.

response.speaker: Katheryne
response.text: Though the Guild has undertaken extensive investigations into that Domain, we have yet to achieve results of any particular value.

response.speaker: Katheryne
response.text: Honglang, who is in charge of this investigation, says that he needs the assistance of a highly adaptable adventurer.

response.speaker: Katheryne
response.text: You were the first person I thought of, Traveler.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: What sort of Domain is this...

response.speaker: Katheryne
response.text: Honglang is at the entrance to this Domain. If you're willing to help, you can go ask him what he needs.

response.speaker: Katheryne
response.text: We're counting on you, Traveler.

dialogues.speaker: Honglang
dialogues.text: Eh? You... Oh, so you're the one Ms. Katheryne called in?

dialogues.speaker: Honglang
dialogues.text: I've heard that you're flexible, highly experienced, and one of our top adventurers to boot...

response.speaker: Honglang
response.text: Wonderful! That's very reassuring indeed.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Still, could you tell me about this Domain...?

response.speaker: Honglang
response.text: Ah, yes, right. Sorry. Let me fill you in...

response.speaker: Honglang
response.text: Well, here's what happened: some time back, a team of adventurers found this strange, large door out in the wild... You're looking at it right now, naturally.

response.speaker: Honglang
response.text: Once they had passed through this gate, the team entered an unknown Domain.

response.speaker: Honglang
response.text: According to the first batch of adventurers, the Domain was just an "empty room" when they first entered it.

choices.text: One moment. What do you mean?

response.speaker: Honglang
response.text: I'm just giving an example. To be precise, it was an area "about 52 paces in length, 52 paces in breadth, and of unknown height."

response.speaker: Honglang
response.text: For 52 paces either way, the area was an ordinary stone-tiled floor, but all the areas beyond were filled with a deep gray smoke.

response.speaker: Honglang
response.text: Also, when someone tried to cross over the border into the area beyond the first 52 paces...

response.speaker: Honglang
response.text: They would either mysteriously change direction and start walking the opposite way, or suddenly disappear and appear behind everyone else.

response.speaker: Honglang
response.text: Whatever the case, it was impossible to cross this 52-pace area.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Did they try using any other tools to explore the place?

response.speaker: Honglang
response.text: They did, of course. But thrown objects would return to their original places, and even the light of torches could not penetrate further than 52 paces away.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: So, you'd like our help in investigating this place?

response.speaker: Honglang
response.text: That is the case. However... you won't just be doing "exploration."

response.speaker: Honglang
response.text: I don't think it's possible to explain out here. Let's continue inside.

choices.text: I guess you could say that...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: You sure this is the same place as that "empty room" you talked about?

choices.text: This just looks like a normal Domain...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Exactly! Isn't this just an ordinary ruin? Y'know, the ones we visit all the time?

response.speaker: Honglang
response.text: This is indeed the Domain we mean to explore.

response.speaker: Honglang
response.text: And as for the reason why it looks like this...

response.speaker: Honglang
response.text: That's because this Domain changed its form not long ago.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Eh?

response.speaker: Player
response.text: It "changed its form"? Into this?

response.speaker: Honglang
response.text: That's right. This Domain transforms based on people's wishes.

response.speaker: Honglang
response.text: According to the leader of the adventure team at that time, they'd started to lose patience with this place after exploring it for some time to no avail.

response.speaker: Honglang
response.text: One of their members began to grumble under their breath.

response.speaker: Honglang
response.text: "If this was an ordinary Domain, we would've finished exploring it long ago."

response.speaker: Honglang
response.text: Hungry and tired as they were, the rest of the team expressed approval of that member's view.

response.speaker: Honglang
response.text: And as more people began to concur, the team suddenly found themselves in "an ordinary Domain."

response.speaker: Honglang
response.text: This "ordinary Domain" contained mechanisms, paths, treasure... even torches that were still burning.

response.speaker: Honglang
response.text: The adventure team judged themselves unable to deal with such a situation, and thus reported back to the Guild immediately.

response.speaker: Honglang
response.text: In response, we quickly sent people to conduct further investigations.

response.speaker: Honglang
response.text: However, all we know even now is that this Domain can change according to a person's will.

response.speaker: Honglang
response.text: If many people enter the Domain at once, then it will react to the person with the strongest thoughts.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Wow! Does this mean that it could create, say, the entire Liyue Harbor in here?

response.speaker: Honglang
response.text: We've tried this, but to no avail. Perhaps our desire to create Liyue Harbor just wasn't strong enough.

response.speaker: Honglang
response.text: Whatever the case, we are currently gathering adventurers to enter this Domain and cause all manner of changes according to their desires.

response.speaker: Honglang
response.text: We hope that we might be able to figure out some of the rules and principles behind the changes this Domain undergoes, and thus get answers from there.

choices.text: In that case, how should I operate this place?

response.speaker: Honglang
response.text: Well, you see that mechanism over there? That's a "trigger" that we put in place. One of our adventurers dreamed this one up, in fact.

response.speaker: Honglang
response.text: In simple terms, his desire was "to be able to change this Domain only when we touch this mechanism."

response.speaker: Honglang
response.text: The Domain answered these wishes, but to ensure that this mechanism remains here, we have to periodically invite him back...

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Huh, to think that you could do something like that...

response.speaker: Honglang
response.text: If not for some of these contingencies, this Domain would keep changing all the time...

response.speaker: Honglang
response.text: But if you look at it from a different angle, this Domain really is quite suited to training adventurers. I mean, just one thought, and all sorts of mechanisms and terrain can emerge in a blink of an eye!

response.speaker: Honglang
response.text: Well, talk is cheap, though... So why don't you give it a go yourself?

response.speaker: Honglang
response.text: See that golden "Adventure Coin" over there? That's a little something we created using our willpower as well.

response.speaker: Honglang
response.text: Try getting ahold of that coin, would you?

choices.text: Is there some special method to all this?

dialogues.speaker: Honglang
dialogues.text: Try getting ahold of that coin, would you?

talks.objective: Give the Adventure Coin to Honglang

dialogues.speaker: Honglang
dialogues.text: Wow! That was pretty impressive. You got the hang of this place really quickly!

dialogues.speaker: Honglang
dialogues.text: In that case, we're counting on you. Use all your wits and imagination to transform this Domain.

dialogues.speaker: Honglang
dialogues.text: I do hope that we'll be able to understand the rules behind the changes of this Domain soon.
